Maya (Growth): Heads-up 10m sync: landing + launch-posts + webinar funnel SEO checklist. Need KW mapping, schema plan, redirects (preserve utm), and internal-link targets. Who's in? :raised_hands:
Ravi: I'll take KW mapping and meta copy variants. Will prioritize transactional + 'how to implement' queries.
Tori: I can handle internal linking and anchor text guidance. Which pillar posts should we push?
Maya (Growth): Prefer these pillars: 'inference economics', 'deployment patterns', 'runtime optimizations' 1st highest traffic pages. Link from each pillar to the webinar landing and to the inference caching doc. Avoid linking to generic homepage.
Kai-SEO: On schema: Event schema for webinar + Speaker Person objects. Add potentialAction for registration if we have RSVP link. Also include FAQ schema for common pre-webinar questions (duration, recording availability). Will draft JSON-LD and share.
Priya: For redirects I want to make sure we preserve utm parameters. Proposed nginx rule uses 302 for temp promos then flip to 301 after QA. Also we'll keep utm in query string for analytics.
Dev-Bot: Crawl snapshot: 9 pages flagged noindex, 2 pages with conflicting canonicals, 4 pages with missing meta-description, 1 redirect loop. Snapshot: https://internal.crawl/snapshots/1717009999
Ravi: KW shortlist for launch posts: "LLM inference platform", "reduce inference latency", "inference cost per token", "dedicated GPU inference", "batching for inference". I'll map to H1/H2 suggestions.
Tori: Internal link plan: add contextual link from 'inference economics' H2 -> landing with anchor "predictable inference cost"; add CTA inline in 'runtime optimizations' to the docs on caching. Limit anchor diversity to 3 variations to avoid dilution.
Maya (Growth): Messaging angle for webinar invite: small 2-sentence: "See how engineering teams cut inference cost and p50 latency without sacrificing accuracy. Live demo + benchmark walk-through." Short, punchy.
Kai-SEO: Note on ratings: don't include aggregateRating unless we have verified reviews. For Event schema, include endDate and location set to 'OnlineEventAttendanceMode'. For speaker sameAs use LinkedIn URLs.
Priya: Redirect snippet (temp -> confirm):
```
# temp promo redirect
rewrite ^/promo/spring22$ /webinar/inference-playbook?utm_source=promo&utm_medium=referral redirect;
# after QA convert to 301 preserving query
return 301 $scheme://$host/webinar/inference-playbook?$query_string;
```
Also flagging legacy /launch-old -> /product/launch-2026 (301).
Dev-Bot: QA crawl scheduled in 6h to verify noindex removals and schema injection.
Ravi: A/B meta-description test: variant A focuses on cost, variant B focuses on latency (we'll run 50/50 for 2 weeks).
Tori: On internal linking timeline: I'll open a content PR with exact anchor text and target URLs. Plan to update 3 pillar posts + two how-to guides.
Maya (Growth): Owners: Ravi = KW + meta tests; Kai-SEO = JSON-LD + schema PR; Priya = redirects + nginx rules; Tori = internal linking PRs. I'll assemble the launch checklist and update the calendar invite. Catch-up tomorrow 9am PT. :sparkles:
